channel.title: Veyago — field notes and research
channel.description: Writing from Veyago Inc., an independent New York software studio: field notes on fast, private websites and the working papers behind the apps.

item.title: From an AI prototype to a production website
item.description: An AI-built site fails in production for four predictable reasons: no real SEO, no structure, no owner of the code, and no plan for the month after launch.
item.dc:creator: Cassian Drefke

item.title: What a $699 website includes, line by line.
item.description: A $699 Veyago website is one page of up to five sections, live in 7 to 10 working days, with hosting in your own account and the code yours. Line by line.
item.dc:creator: Cassian Drefke

item.title: Why your Wix site is slow (and how to fix it)
item.description: A Wix or Squarespace site is slow because the builder ships one runtime for every feature, whether your page uses them or not. Here is where the weight is.
item.dc:creator: Cassian Drefke

item.title: The Unkept Life
item.description: Why personal life admin fails - and the case for a private, on-device system of record. The research behind Kept.
item.dc:creator: Cassian Drefke

item.title: On your side of the line
item.description: Most software gets smarter by taking your life to a server. I'm building the opposite, and 2026 is the year that bet finally makes sense.
item.dc:creator: Cassian Drefke

item.title: The Edge Moves In
item.description: How intelligence is migrating to the device, WWDC 2026 as its consumer inflection point, and what it means for privacy-first software.
item.dc:creator: Cassian Drefke
